title: Snowman Shake ☃️ Winter Dance Song for Kids | Christmas Brain Break | Tiny Turn Up
description:
Roll it, stack it, SHAKE IT! ☃️ A winter dance-along for kids ages 3–7. Build a snowman, shiver, melt and shake with Jojo, Kiki and Waddles!

Great for December and January classroom brain breaks, indoor recess, preschool movement time and holiday parties.

New Tiny Turn Up dance songs every week!
#wintersongsforkids #kidsdance #brainbreak
thumbnail_prompt: Jojo and Kiki in colorful scarves and beanies shaking wildly next to a giant smiling dancing snowman, Waddles half-melted in a puddle with a confused face; snowy purple court, snowflakes everywhere. Right third: bold text 'SNOWMAN SHAKE!' in icy blue and white with thick black outline, and small text 'TINY TURN UP' with a gold crown.
